title: Back in Black
reason: Classic studio master with natural drum bleed and slight timing drift.
tip: Listen for room noise and tiny imperfections instead of metronome-perfect hits.

title: Enter Sandman (AI clone)
reason: Vocals and guitars are locked to the grid with almost no breath noise.
tip: AI clones often sound too clean and consistent across every phrase.

title: Stairway to Heaven
reason: Guitar dynamics and pick noise build gradually in a very human way.
tip: Humans naturally push and pull tempo as a song swells.

title: Highway to Hell (AI)
reason: The rasp is close but the phrasing is too even and never fully strains.
tip: Cloned voices mimic timbre but struggle with natural strain and fatigue.

title: Bohemian Rhapsody (AI)
reason: Stacked harmonies are perfectly balanced with almost no wobble between parts.
tip: AI choirs often sound like one voice copied many times instead of a messy group.

title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
reason: Vocal rasp and uneven scream intensity are classic Cobain, not a smooth clone.
tip: AI vocals tend to keep the same tone and intensity on every line.
